title: MapleStory Classic Magician Leveling Guide
author: Nia Meow
summary: A level 10-30 Magician route covering INT and LUK allocation, Magic Claw progression, mage damage scaling, wand and staff choices, armor, and branch preparation.

sections.title: Core build
items: INT drives damage while LUK is mainly an equipment requirement.
Build around Magic Claw before secondary utility skills.

sections.title: Equipment
items: Compare wands and staves at practical upgrade levels.
Avoid spending extra AP solely for short-lived armor upgrades.

sections.title: Second job
items: The shared build leads into Fire/Poison, Ice/Lightning, or Cleric.
Choose the branch based on damage pattern, support, and preferred training route.

notes: Structured MPStorys reading edition verified in Chrome on 2026-07-27.
steps: Allocate INT and only required LUK.
Build the first-job Magic Claw foundation.
Choose a second-job branch at level 30.
